Search for icons

Source: R/browse.R
iconify_search.Rd

Queries /search.

Usage

iconify_search(query, prefixes = NULL, limit = 64)

Arguments

query

Search term.

prefixes

Optional character vector of icon set prefixes to restrict the search to. A prefix ending in "-" matches partially, so "mdi-" matches "mdi-light".

limit

Maximum number of results, 1 to 999. The API returns at least 32 results per request; extra results are dropped.

Value

A data frame with columns id ("prefix:name"), prefix and name.

See also

iconify_sets(), iconify_icons()

Examples

iconify_search("home", prefixes = c("mdi", "tabler"), limit = 40)
#>                        id prefix               name
#> 1                mdi:home    mdi               home
#> 2        mdi:home-outline    mdi       home-outline
#> 3             tabler:home tabler               home
#> 4      tabler:home-filled tabler        home-filled
